memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Ephron answered Abraham, "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between me and you? Bury your dead." Abraham agreed to Ephron's terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants. - Gen 23:14-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Ephron finally names his price - four hundred shekels of silver, a considerable sum - while pretending it hardly matters: "what is that between me and you?" And Abraham, without haggling, simply "weighed out" the full amount. He paid the complete price, publicly, in front of witnesses, using the standard weight recognised by all. The transaction was fair, transparent, and final.

Notice Abraham's dignity and generosity. He does not argue over the price or try to beat Ephron down, even though the sum was likely high. He pays what was asked, in full, openly. There is something noble in a person who deals so straightforwardly, refusing to quibble or manipulate, choosing instead to be fair and generous.

This willingness to pay the full price, publicly and honestly, secured the purchase beyond all dispute. Abraham now had a legitimate, unquestionable claim to this piece of land. His integrity protected him and honoured everyone involved.

There is a quiet gospel echo in this idea of a price fully paid. Our salvation, too, rested on a price - one we could never pay ourselves. And Jesus paid it in full. "You were bought at a price" (1 Cor 6:20); His last cry from the cross was "It is finished" (John 19:30) - a word that meant "paid in full." Abraham weighed out silver for a field; Christ poured out His life for us. Rest today in the price fully paid on your behalf, and let your own dealings reflect His costly integrity.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you deal fairly and generously, without manipulation?
- Have you rested in the full price Christ paid for your salvation?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, help me deal fairly and honestly, willing to pay what is right without quibbling. And thank You most of all for the price Jesus paid in full for me. I rest in His finished work, my debt completely settled.
Amen.
